name: [⚡UPD] Mount JadiJadi
desc:
🌄 Mount JadiJadi (Looking for a Cute Mountain? This is the place!)
Feel the urge to climb with friends to the top!

The adventure begins with a beautiful path, overcoming obstacles—from easy to challenging. Every step tells a story, so don't forget to share your best moments with your friends on Mount JadiJadi. Who knows, your experience might inspire others to try this exciting adventure!

✨ Exciting Features:
+5 SUMMIT!
FREE SPEEDCOIL!
🐄 Cow and Shark Rides (Secret: Ride the ⚫Toothless and ⚪Light Fury at the top towards the beach)
Carrying System (Many interesting options)
Funny Costumes
Music
Aura
Pets
Funny Sounds
Hot Air Balloons
Easy Route, very mobile-friendly.
Hold your friends who are struggling to overcome obstacles.
Collect climbs to the top to unlock special features.

🔥 So, do you want to prove your climbing skills alone, or is it more fun with a team?
Let's prove it!
